Dream 2026-11-22 linked 9 vignettes from 6 days to this record as evidence. Agree if they belong here; disagree to have a later dream drop them.

- undated · touches · "as the context grows, we refine the domain, problem, persona" (Vignettes are short-term memory; dreams build the model; affirmation freezes it)
- 2026-10-24 · retells · "these are interconnected vignettes. We will cluster and synthesise them, and buld up meaning in cyles and spirals." (Vignettes, spirals and the paradox of boundaries (2026-10-24))
- 2026-10-25 · touches · "We can trace our refined records back to their context by doing this" (A chat opens a container: the narrative is the initial semantic layer (2026-10-25))
- 2026-10-30 · retells · "gradually develop our understanding before they hit formal decisions" (Vignette 2026-10-30: an exercise is a question we explore before it becomes a decision)
- 2026-11-04 · touches · "The editor should be able to simply present a view that builds up structured bavkground." (Build up structured background from vignettes; a tick and bin instead of affirmation (2026-11-04))
- 2026-11-06 · touches · "Let's capture a process and see if we can prototype a tool that will guide the process of refining a domain." (Refining a domain is the essay process with a blueprint instead of a paragraph: the soup needs a tool to work through the underlying material (2026-11-06))
- 2026-11-06 · touches · "AI produced summary of the text that sits a layer up. I should also be able to clone and edit that summary." (A summary layer I can clone and edit; vignettes strengthen or weaken assumptions; I can only affirm in context, and a domain is our current best guess (2026-11-06))
- 2026-11-06 · touches · "AI can build the coherence layer. Building up patterns and then refining them. Turning my words into structured data." (Affirmations and vignettes are anchors; AI brings the coherence in between, and affirmation is rarer than we expect (2026-11-06))
- 2026-11-06 · touches · "I need to see my original words. The method editor needs to show me what AI has done next to what I said." (Once the words are written they are hard for me to change, in this work too: I need to see my words next to what AI did, and I still can't manage affirmations (2026-11-06))
